hero.heading: WE MAP SINAI.

trips.title: Day trips & adventures
trips.body: Sea, desert, mountains or a night out — one experience, booked on its own.

packages.title: Packages

signature.title: Something special

curated.title: Curated for the days ahead

discover.title: Discover

request.title: Request

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: We check real availability with our partners and confirm with you.

experience.title: Experience
experience.body: Arrive, and let the local team handle the details.

addMore.title: Add more
addMore.body: Extend your trip with more experiences whenever you like.

stays.title: Sleep somewhere that fits your trip
stays.subtitle: Hotels, chalets and camps in Dahab — each priced by the room, not guessed.

explore.title: Find your kind of Sinai
explore.subtitle: Sea, desert, mountains, culture, nights out — every trip is tagged by what it actually is.
explore.truthLine: Every trip picks up and drops off at your accommodation in Dahab.

packages.subtitle: A Dahab Stay Package and a Sinai Experience Package are paid on different terms, so we always show them as two separate lanes — never one generic bundle.

stayLane.title: Dahab Stay Packages
stayLane.body: A bundle of Sinai trips built around your stay in Dahab.

experienceLane.title: Sinai Experience Packages
experienceLane.body: Several Sinai experiences bundled together at a better total than booking each apart — paid after confirmation.

signature.title: Tell us the experience. We'll build the journey.
signature.body: Some trips shouldn't be built piece by piece. Signature Experiences bring the place, the activity and the right partners together around one idea.

community.title: Know the place before you arrive
community.subtitle: Stories, guides and local knowledge from people who actually live Sinai.

shop.title: Take a little of Sinai with you

merch.title: WEEMAP Merch
merch.body: Pieces made with the spirit of Sinai — for the trip, the sea, and after you're back.

rent.title: Rent
rent.body: Selected gear by the day, so you can travel lighter and enjoy more.

shop.emptyLine: Merch and rentals are on the way — for now, everything else on this page is ready to book.

trust.title: Built by a team that actually lives here

local.title: A local team in Dahab
local.body: We're based here, not routing your trip through a call centre elsewhere.

payment.title: Payment only after confirmation

pickup.title: Pickup from your Dahab stay
